title: PruneSummary
description: Terminal result payload for `--json` / `--jsonl` structured output.

bytes_freed.description: Total bytes freed (or would-be-freed in dry-run).

chunks_pruned.description: Number of chunk cache objects pruned (or would-be-pruned).

dry_run.description: Whether this was a dry-run (no mutations).

objects_pruned.description: Number of objects pruned (or would-be-pruned in dry-run).

shards_pruned.description: Number of shard cache objects pruned (or would-be-pruned).

xorbs_pruned.description: Number of xorb cache objects pruned (or would-be-pruned).
